svg.title: Rolling Update
svg.desc: Rolling Update. Replace instances batch by batch while the service stays up. Step 1, Surge one new instance: Four instances run v1. A v2 instance starts in the surge slot and gets no traffic until it is ready. Step 2, Swap one at a time: When a v2 is ready, one v1 drains and leaves, then the next v2 starts: at least 4 ready, at most 5. Step 3, A bad instance stalls it: The last v2 fails its readiness check: it gets no traffic and the rollout stalls, not the service. Step 4, Fix and finish: After the fix it turns ready and the rollout finishes with four v2. Revision 1 is kept for rollback.

g.text: Four instances run v1. A v2 instance starts in the surge slot and gets no traffic until it is ready.
When a v2 is ready, one v1 drains and leaves, then the next v2 starts: at least 4 ready, at most 5.
The last v2 fails its readiness check: it gets no traffic and the rollout stalls, not the service.
After the fix it turns ready and the rollout finishes with four v2. Revision 1 is kept for rollback.
sends requests only to ready instances
every request is served by v1
v1 and v2 serve side by side
so the two versions must be compatible
every request is served by v2
one batch at a time, gated by readiness
repeat: start one v2 → wait until it is ready → drain one v1
passed: roll back, or fix forward
configuration fixed: the instance restarts and passes its check
revision 1 is kept: rolling back is one command
